_help: POKÉMON FOODS (2026-11-24). WHICH Pokémon likes which food is the 'Food' column of Pokemon_Food_And_Beds.csv (one food per Pokémon, many Pokémon per food). This file only holds each food's details: 'chance' = % a Pokémon that likes it befriends you when offered one (talking to it on land, or landing it on the rod while the food is in your bag), 'description' = bag/shop text, 'sprite' = file name in Image_Assets/Food (no .png; leave it out to use the food's own name). A food named in the CSV but missing here still works, with chance 50. Read by Scripts/Objects_And_Classes/Overworld_Pokemon/Following_Pokemon.gd. DEL menu 'Give test foods' gives 3 of every food.

Rat Cheese.description: A pungent wedge of cheese. Small rodent Pokémon can't resist it.

Luscious Leaves.description: Crisp, juicy leaves that bug Pokémon love to munch.

Nutritious Bird Seed.description: A seed mix for bird Pokémon.

Fish Flakes.description: Flaky fish food. A fish that bites while you carry it may want to come with you.
